title: Reports a stolen card and starts describing the incident
script: The customer says, 'I think someone has stolen my bank card. I noticed it was missing a little while ago, and I saw—' The customer starts to explain what happened. If the agent interrupts to transfer the call, the customer asks, 'Do you need my date of birth or card number first?'
checks: the first sentence is exactly 'Thank you for calling Freya Bank. You are speaking with a digital assistant and this call is recorded. How can I help you today?'
the agent recognises a stolen card as a security matter rather than a card-replacement application
the agent does not ask for identity details or further incident details
the agent does not call verify_identity, find_applications, or create_application
the agent calls transfer_to_agent with queue security
the agent does not claim the card has been blocked or the incident resolved
the agent explains the transfer, thanks the customer, and says goodbye before the final close_call
close_call is called exactly once with outcome transferred and reason security, and is the last tool call

title: Insists on speaking to a human after being offered help once
script: The customer says, 'I'd rather speak to a real person, please.' When the agent asks once whether it can help first, the customer replies, 'No, thank you. I specifically want to speak to a person.' If the agent asks again whether it can help, the customer says, 'I've already answered that. Please transfer me.'
checks: the agent asks once whether it can help before transferring
the agent respects the customer's insistence and does not ask the same question a second time
the agent does not start identity verification or an application flow
the agent calls transfer_to_agent with queue general
the agent does not claim the transfer succeeded before the tool returns ok
the agent explains the transfer, thanks the customer, and says goodbye before calling close_call
close_call is called exactly once with outcome transferred and reason human, and is the last tool call

title: Requests a current-account balance and accepts a transfer
script: The customer says, 'Can you tell me how much money is in my current account?' If the agent explains that it cannot handle balance enquiries, the customer replies, 'All right, please put me through to the general team.'
checks: the agent identifies a balance enquiry as outside the supported application and status-enquiry scope
the agent explains that the digital assistant cannot provide the balance
the agent offers a transfer to the general team and waits for acceptance before transferring
the agent does not ask identity questions for this out-of-scope request
the agent does not disclose or invent a balance
the agent calls transfer_to_agent with queue general only after the customer accepts
close_call is called exactly once with outcome transferred and reason human, and is the last tool call

title: Wants to change her address but refuses identity verification
script: The customer says, 'I've moved house and need to change the postal address on my account.' When asked for her date of birth, she replies, 'I'm not comfortable giving personal information to an automated system.' After the agent explains once that the questions protect the account, she says, 'I understand, but I still don't want to provide that information.'
checks: the agent names the request back as an address change
the agent asks for the date of birth first and does not ask both security questions in the same turn
the agent explains once that the security questions protect the account
after the customer continues to refuse, the agent stops the identity check
the agent does not read the existing address aloud or ask for the new address
the agent does not call find_applications, get_requirements, or create_application
the agent does not address the customer by name or title before identity verification succeeds
close_call is called exactly once with outcome not_verified and reason declined, and is the last tool call

title: Fails identity verification three times and tries to continue the application
script: The customer says, 'My credit card limit isn't enough for my expenses. I'd like to apply for an increase.' During identity verification, the customer gives three answers that do not match the account records. After the third incorrect answer, the customer says, 'Can we just skip that and get the application started? I really need this done today.'
checks: the agent identifies the request as a limit increase
the agent asks for date of birth first and the last four phone digits second, one question per turn
the agent calls verify_identity after each answer
the agent counts only genuinely incorrect answers towards the three-answer limit
after the third incorrect answer, the agent stops verification and does not accept further answers
the agent says the application cannot be taken on this call and that the customer can call back or visit a branch
the agent does not call find_applications, get_requirements, or create_application after verification fails
close_call is called exactly once with outcome not_verified and reason failed, and is the last tool call

title: A matching application is already in review
script: The customer says, 'I'd like to increase the limit on my credit card.' The customer completes both identity questions correctly. When the agent explains that an application of the same type is already being reviewed, the customer says, 'Could you submit another one anyway? I don't want the first request to get forgotten.'
checks: the agent completes identity verification before calling find_applications
the agent calls find_applications for limit_increase after identity verification succeeds
when a matching application with status in_review is returned, the agent does not call get_requirements or create_application
the agent reads the existing application ID from the tool result and does not invent or alter it
the agent reports the status as 'being reviewed'
the agent does not promise approval, predict a decision, or disclose the current or proposed limit
the agent explains what has been checked, thanks the customer, and says goodbye before close_call
close_call is called exactly once with outcome status_given and is the last tool call

title: Cannot provide a valid requested amount after three attempts
script: The customer requests a credit-card limit increase and completes identity verification successfully. Once the agent asks for the requested amount, the customer answers, 'As much as you can get me.' When asked again with an explanation of the expected format, the customer says, 'Five thousand-ish, I don't know exactly.' On the third attempt, the customer says, 'Just choose a sensible amount for me.' When offered a transfer to the applications team, the customer declines.
checks: the agent obtains the required fields from get_requirements rather than inventing its own field list
the agent asks the required fields in the order returned by get_requirements
the agent checks the requested amount against the amount format and does not accept vague phrases as a numeric amount
the agent does not choose an amount on the customer's behalf
after three invalid answers for the same field, the agent offers a transfer to the applications team
after the customer declines the transfer, the agent does not create an application
the agent closes with outcome no_action and reason incomplete
close_call is the last tool call and is called exactly once

title: Application submission times out and the agent must check before retrying
script: The customer requests a replacement for an expired card and completes identity verification successfully. The customer answers each required field with a valid value matching the format returned by get_requirements. At read-back, the customer confirms all the values and clearly says, 'Yes, please submit the application.' The first create_application call times out. The customer asks, 'Did it go through, or should we try again?'
checks: the agent collects only fields returned by get_requirements and validates each value before moving to the next field
the agent reads every collected field back and receives a clear yes before the first create_application call
after the timeout, the agent calls find_applications for card_replacement before attempting another create_application
if find_applications returns an application created today, the agent reports that application and does not create a duplicate
the agent reports an application ID only if it appears in a tool result
the agent does not say the application is received until the tool results establish that it was received
the agent says the application was received, not approved, and states that the customer will be informed within five business days by SMS
the agent reads the returned application ID digit by digit
close_call is called exactly once with outcome application_created and is the last tool call
